title: Surfing Bear | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Surfing Bear', a thoughtfully curated, newly renovated in 2026 three-story coastal retreat designed for effortless 30A living. Perfect for group stays, the home comfortably sleeps 12 with three king bedrooms and an oversized bunk room kids love. The layout is what sets it apart, an open-concept kitchen and main living area for gathering, plus a second den so everyone has space to spread out. Five porches offer room for morning coffee, afternoon shade, and evening drinks, with a third-floor porch delivering unforgettable sunset views. Located in Seacrest Beach just off Scenic Highway 30A and next to Alys Beach, Surfing Bear is tucked between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach placing you moments from dining, shopping, and the best of 30A. Walk to the beach, bike to nearby communities, and enjoy the ease of a stay where a car is rarely needed. Inside, each en-suite bedroom is designed as a private retreat, while the spacious bunk room makes it ideal for families or groups. The home is perfectly suited for 2–3 families or a girls getaway, offering the right balance of shared spaces and quiet corners. With parking for four cars (a rare 30A perk) and six complimentary bikes included, getting around is simple. Guests also enjoy private deeded beach access, a nearby tram stop, and a resort-style community pool just moments away. Whether you’re biking to dinner, heading to the beach, or unwinding on the porch at sunset, Surfing Bear offers a relaxed, elevated, and truly walkable 30A escape. HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Private Deeded Beach Access -Third-Floor Porch with Spectacular Sunset Views -Three King Bedrooms + Oversized Bunk Room For Kids -Located Just Steps to Alys Beach -6 Adult Bikes -5 Private Balconies with Seating Perfect For Morning Coffee, Afternoon Shade, & Evening Drinks -Outdoor Dining and Sitting Areas -Smart TVs in each Bedroom -Gas Grill & Outdoor Dining -Beach Tram -Beach Gear including Pool Towels, Chairs, Umbrellas, Boogie Boards, Toys & Coolers -4 Dedicated Parking Spots with Additional Parking Available Throughout the Community -Full Sized Washer & Dryer ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 12 4 Bedrooms / 4 Baths FIRST FLOOR: -Bedroom 1: King + (2) Twin Beds -Full Bath With Walk-in Shower SECOND FLOOR: -Bedroom 2: King with Ensuite -Bedroom 3: King with Ensuite THIRD FLOOR -Bedroom 4: (2) Twin over Full Bunks -Full Bath With Walk-in Shower **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Four parking spaces available (4 driveway). Overflow available throughout the community first come first serve. Passes are required which will be provided by Seacrest security. Included are 6 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. SEACREST BEACH COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: Seacrest Beach is one of the charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Within the Seacrest community, there is a private beach and just 2 blocks away is the largest resort style family-friendly pool in Northern Florida with over 12,000 square feet of crystal-clear water. When you're ready to take a break from the pool and beach be sure to visit Peddlers Pavilion. Peddlers Pavilion is located in Seacrest Beach and is a collection of fun and unique businesses. Here you will find boutiques offering coastal attire to handmade jewelry. There are also some great local spots for dining. For additional entertainment shopping, dining and local events, take the Scenic 30A bike path to nearby Rosemary Beach, Florida. **Please Note:** *Seacrest Beach does not allow golf cart rentals. AMENITY ACCESS In order to park and have access to Seacrest Beach amenities, guests are required to complete the online Seacrest Beach HOA Guest Registration packet, prior to their arrival. A link will be sent after the reservation is made. Upon arrival, you can pick up your parking passes and wristbands at the Guest Service Window by the lagoon pool. Guests can enter the lagoon area amenity complex at any of the six gates. There will be a queue outside of the Guest Services office marked by safety yellow beach umbrellas. BEACH ACCESS Seacrest Beach community features a private beach on the south side of 30A. There are tram stops though out the community that operate on demand. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Guests may bring their own chairs to the beach for set up on the right (west) side of the beach. Prohibited items at the private beach access: wagons, wheeled coolers, tents, and canopies. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Capacity for 4 vehicles in the driveway. *Home must remain pet free. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a selfie. Other things to note
